name: Chikorita
description_en: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
description_pt: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Bayleef
description_en: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
description_pt: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Meganium
description_en: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
description_pt: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

name: Cyndaquil
description_en: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
description_pt: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
description_en: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
description_pt: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Typhlosion
description_en: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
description_pt: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Totodile
description_en: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
description_pt: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

name: Croconaw
description_en: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
description_pt: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Feraligatr
description_en: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
description_pt: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Sentret
description_en: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
description_pt: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

name: Furret
description_en: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
description_pt: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Hoothoot
description_en: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.
description_pt: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.

name: Noctowl
description_en: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
description_pt: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Ledyba
description_en: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
description_pt: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.

name: Ledian
description_en: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
description_pt: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

name: Spinarak
description_en: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
description_pt: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

name: Ariados
description_en: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
description_pt: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

name: Crobat
description_en: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.
description_pt: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.

name: Chinchou
description_en: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
description_pt: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Lanturn
description_en: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
description_pt: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”

name: Pichu
description_en: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.
description_pt: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

name: Cleffa
description_en: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.
description_pt: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

name: Igglybuff
description_en: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
description_pt: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

name: Togepi
description_en: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.
description_pt: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
description_en: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.
description_pt: No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.

name: Natu
description_en: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
description_pt: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

name: Xatu
description_en: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
description_pt: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

name: Mareep
description_en: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
description_pt: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
description_en: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
description_pt: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
description_en: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
description_pt: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.

name: Bellossom
description_en: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
description_pt: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

name: Marill
description_en: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.
description_pt: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.

name: Azumarill
description_en: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
description_pt: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.

name: Sudowoodo
description_en: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
description_pt: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Politoed
description_en: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
description_pt: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.

name: Hoppip
description_en: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
description_pt: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
description_en: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
description_pt: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

name: Jumpluff
description_en: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
description_pt: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Aipom
description_en: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.
description_pt: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Sunkern
description_en: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
description_pt: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.

name: Sunflora
description_en: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
description_pt: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Yanma
description_en: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
description_pt: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Wooper
description_en: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
description_pt: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
description_en: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
description_pt: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Espeon
description_en: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.
description_pt: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

name: Umbreon
description_en: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.
description_pt: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

name: Murkrow
description_en: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.
description_pt: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.

name: Slowking
description_en: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.
description_pt: Being bitten by SHELLDER gave it intelligence comparable to that of award-winning scientists.

name: Misdreavus
description_en: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.
description_pt: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Unown
description_en: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
description_pt: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.

name: Wobbuffet
description_en: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
description_pt: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Girafarig
description_en: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
description_pt: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.

name: Pineco
description_en: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.
description_pt: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

name: Forretress
description_en: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.
description_pt: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

name: Dunsparce
description_en: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.
description_pt: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Gligar
description_en: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.
description_pt: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.

name: Steelix
description_en: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
description_pt: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

name: Snubbull
description_en: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.
description_pt: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by women to be cute.

name: Granbull
description_en: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.
description_pt: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

name: Qwilfish
description_en: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
description_pt: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Scizor
description_en: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
description_pt: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: Shuckle
description_en: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.
description_pt: It stores berries in its shell. The berries eventually ferment to become delicious juices.

name: Heracross
description_en: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
description_pt: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Sneasel
description_en: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
description_pt: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Teddiursa
description_en: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
description_pt: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
description_en: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
description_pt: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Slugma
description_en: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
description_pt: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
description_en: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
description_pt: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.

name: Swinub
description_en: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.
description_pt: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
description_en: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.
description_pt: The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.

name: Corsola
description_en: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
description_pt: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

name: Remoraid
description_en: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.
description_pt: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

name: Octillery
description_en: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.
description_pt: While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.

name: Delibird
description_en: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.
description_pt: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has the habit of sharing food with people lost in mountains.

name: Mantine
description_en: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
description_pt: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Skarmory
description_en: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.
description_pt: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Houndour
description_en: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.
description_pt: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
description_en: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.
description_pt: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Kingdra
description_en: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.
description_pt: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

name: Phanpy
description_en: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
description_pt: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
description_en: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
description_pt: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

name: Porygon2
description_en: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.
description_pt: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

name: Stantler
description_en: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
description_pt: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Smeargle
description_en: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.
description_pt: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

name: Tyrogue
description_en: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.
description_pt: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

name: Hitmontop
description_en: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.
description_pt: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by ten.

name: Smoochum
description_en: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.
description_pt: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

name: Elekid
description_en: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.
description_pt: They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.

name: Magby
description_en: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.
description_pt: This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.

name: Miltank
description_en: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.
description_pt: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Blissey
description_en: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.
description_pt: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.

name: Raikou
description_en: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
description_pt: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

name: Entei
description_en: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
description_pt: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Suicune
description_en: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
description_pt: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Larvitar
description_en: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
description_pt: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
description_en: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
description_pt: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Tyranitar
description_en: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
description_pt: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Lugia
description_en: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
description_pt: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Ho-Oh
description_en: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
description_pt: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

name: Celebi
description_en: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
description_pt: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
